name: Fluid Checks & Top-Offs
summary: Verified (secondary): N52 has no dipstick and oil level is read electronically; coolant should be BMW-type blue G48-style mixed about 50/50 with distilled water and checked only on a cold engine; brake fluid is DOT 4 with a roughly 2-year change interval. Single-source or conflicting: coolant capacity (8.2 L manual / 8.5 L auto from an E89 Z4 thread), expansion tank and brake reservoir locations, power steering type (one source says hydraulic, another implies EPS was available), brake-fluid reservoir access via cabin filter housing. Missing: washer fluid spec/capacity, power steering fluid spec, automatic transmission and differential service info, exact iDrive/cluster path for the oil level check, and any BMW document. This guide is safe to build only as 'check levels and top off' with owner-confirmed locations; no full flush procedures.
variantDependencies: Engine: oil-level is electronic on N52; N51 not confirmed but assumed similar (UNVERIFIED).
Transmission: manual vs auto affects coolant capacity (8.2 vs 8.5 L, per Z4 forum for E89, NOT E90) and trans fluid; auto fluid spec MISSING.
Drive: xDrive adds transfer case/front diff fluids; sources only cover RWD diff in search listings (unread).
Steering: hydraulic vs electric power steering may depend on build date; the car must be inspected for a PS reservoir.
Cabin-filter housing at base of windshield may need removal to reach the brake reservoir (E92 M3 source).

steps.title: Prep
steps.instruction: Park on level ground, engine off. For coolant, wait until the engine is fully cold.
warnings: Never open the expansion tank cap on a hot engine.

steps.title: Engine oil
steps.instruction: Read the electronic oil level after the engine has been warm and driven for several minutes; wait roughly 20 min of driving after adding before judging again. Menu path in iDrive/cluster for this car is not confirmed.
steps.status: VERIFIED for behavior (S5c, Z4L); menu path MISSING
warnings: Do not overfill from a stale reading.

steps.title: Coolant
steps.instruction: Locate the translucent expansion tank (TP: passenger side near the firewall on E90; single source). With engine cold, open cap slowly and check level against MIN/MAX; top up only with the correct blue 50/50 mix; refit cap fully.
warnings: Do not mix coolant types. Low levels repeatedly = leak.

steps.title: Brake fluid
steps.instruction: Find the brake reservoir at the driver's side base of the windshield; it is reported to be under a plastic cover and (E92 M3) accessed by removing the cabin-filter housing. Fill only to just below MAX with DOT 4.
steps.status: CONFLICT/SINGLE_SOURCE (BB: remove cabin filter housing; GS: plastic cover)
warnings: Brake fluid damages paint; wipe spills with water.
A falling level may mean worn pads or a leak.

steps.title: Washer fluid
steps.instruction: Fill the washer reservoir. Location, capacity and any additive requirements not found.

steps.title: Power steering
steps.instruction: Only if the car has a hydraulic pump and reservoir; inspect and top up with the type printed on the cap. Existence on this car is unconfirmed.

steps.title: Transmission/differential
steps.instruction: Not a routine owner check; out of scope until BMW service data is obtained.

safety: Engine cold before opening coolant cap.
Brake fluid is corrosive to paint and is hygroscopic; keep containers sealed.
Brake system leaks or low fluid are safety-critical; seek inspection.
Coolant is toxic to pets; clean spills.
